fields.summary_ko.0: Micron Technology (NASDAQ:MU) target price of $995.75 offers 11.24% upside from current $895.13, with over 75% of fiscal 2027 volumes already locked in.
fields.summary_ko.1: MU declined 15.97% over the past month but rose 213.77% year-to-date; Q4 revenue of $54.23B exceeded estimate of $50.97B and grew 379.3% year-over-year.
fields.summary_ko.2: HBM memory high-margin business and 2027 HBM4E production ramp support bull case target of $1,348.70, while memory cyclicality concerns and customer concentration present bear case risk of $748.96.
